goals.title: Map PR inbox Bitbucket cache and rate-limit paths
goals.objective: Inspect the Electron main-process Bitbucket/inbox modules, renderer PR inbox hooks/screens, background prefetch behavior, desktop IPC contracts, and existing tests to produce a repo-native map of what data is cached, what is fetched live, what refreshes in the background, and where rate-limit or stuck-loading failures can occur. Evidence must cite files and current commands without changing production behavior except documentation if needed.

goals.title: Make cache and background activity explicit in the PR inbox
goals.objective: Update PR inbox data contracts and UI so users and developers can tell whether inbox rows/details/diffs are fresh, cached, stale, refreshing, prefetched, or blocked by a rate limit. Add focused tests for visible cache/background states and ensure errors are actionable instead of leaving the app stuck.

goals.title: Harden Bitbucket request scheduling and caching foundations
goals.objective: Centralize or clarify Bitbucket request deduplication, cache lookup/write policy, concurrency limits, rate-limit backoff, and stale-while-revalidate behavior for inbox and diff-loading paths. Prevent background work from exhausting rate limits needed for foreground review. Cover the behavior with unit tests around cache hits, misses, stale data, retries, and rate-limit responses.

goals.title: Stabilize foreground PR review and diff loading flows
goals.objective: Fix app-stuck cases around desktop:invoke, PR selection, and diff loading by adding bounded waits, cancellation or supersession where appropriate, resilient error propagation, retry affordances, and state cleanup. Verify with targeted tests for stuck IPC/error transitions and diff-loading failures.

goals.title: Add reliable development scripts, diagnostics, and skills for PR inbox work
goals.objective: Create or update repo-native scripts/docs/skills so developers can reliably run the PR inbox, inspect/reset relevant caches, reproduce Bitbucket rate-limit and cached-data scenarios, and execute focused checks. Keep scripts aligned with the repository package manager and existing test/build conventions, and document the workflow clearly.

goals.title: Land incrementally and pass the final quality gate
goals.objective: Review all changes for coherence, ensure each completed slice has a logical commit and push when execution reaches it, run targeted and broad verification needed for confidence, run ai-slop-cleaner on changed files, rerun verification, complete the independent final code-review gate, and checkpoint the durable ultragoal ledger with final evidence.
